title.zh: MuMu ReSukiSU · MuMu 模拟器 ReSukiSU Root 安装与回退脚本
title.en: MuMu ReSukiSU · ReSukiSU Root Installer & Rollback Scripts for MuMu Android 15

summary.zh: 针对特定版本 MuMu Android 15 x86_64 模拟器的 ReSukiSU Root 镜像组装与单实例安装脚本，写入前会核对原始镜像指纹并保留备份以便回退。
summary.en: ReSukiSU root image builder and single-instance installer for a specific MuMu Android 15 x86_64 emulator build, verifying image fingerprints and keeping backups for rollback.

zh: 在本地对用户自己的模拟器原始镜像做离线替换组装，写入前核对目标版本的文件指纹
只修改指定的单个已停止模拟器实例，不改动公共基础盘，并支持一键恢复原状
已在该目标版本的模拟器上验证过 32/64 位 su 调用与重启保留
en: Builds patched images offline from the user's own base image after verifying target file fingerprints
Applies changes to a single stopped emulator instance with backup and rollback support
Tested for 32/64-bit su invocation and persistence across reboots on the target emulator version

milestone.zh: 已完成目标 Android 15 x86_64 模拟器版本的安装、回退与 su 调用测试。
milestone.en: Install, rollback, and su checks completed for the target Android 15 x86_64 emulator build.
